summary: Read a list of integers and a step count k. Rotate the whole list toward the right by k places. Values that leave the right end come back at the left end and keep their relative order. Write the list after that rotation. The length n satisfies 1 <= n <= 2 * 10^4. Each integer lies between -2^31 and 2^31 - 1, including both ends. The step count satisfies 0 <= k <= 10^5. k may be larger than n. Any method is fine as long as the written order matches a right rotation by k places.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count, that many integers, and one target integer.
